svg.title: Kindle Dashboard mockup
svg.text: Done tasks sink to the bottom -- they don't vanish.
Telegram has real digits; the on-screen keyboard doesn't, by design.
Whole card is the tap target -- forces an immediate re-fetch.
Same as tapping a page number or the arrow buttons.
Press again -> exact previous tab, no restart. CPU use drops ~175x while locked.
Press power again, with a PIN set
Only shown if you've set a PIN with /setpin. Wrong digits just clear and let you retry.
